title: SOX IT general controls
source: IT general controls as commonly scoped for SOX Section 404 (PCAOB AS 2201, COSO 2013)

controls.ITGC-SOD: Segregation of duties: no one person both makes and approves a change to financial programs or data
controls.ITGC-PCC: Program change control: changes to programs and configuration are authorized and approved before they run
controls.ITGC-MDA: Master data authorization: changes to master data, such as vendor bank details, are approved by someone other than the requester

limits.ITGC-MDA: Shown for master data in tables the stack observes: a write to a table the mandate does not grant is refused, and widening the mandate needs its quorum.
